howitzer.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One PRELIMINARY human Expedition RTS self-propelled HOWITZER silhouette comparison board, TWO neutral states of SAME vehicle side by side: LEFT transport with cannon lowered and support legs folded, RIGHT deployed with cannon elevated and FOUR proposed stabilizer feet unfolded onto ground. Same two-track chassis, same cabin, same ONE artillery gun in both views. Clearly unlike low armored tank: LONGER chassis, low small closed forward driving/service block, REAR exposed tall artillery cradle with a visible broad gun pivot and long slender cannon, no enclosed tank turret. Only ONE barrel in each depiction, exactly TWO continuous track belts in each vehicle. Support geometry is preliminary visual proposal, not a fixed production design. Human faction sand beige protective housings, graphite exposed cradle and gun mechanics, satin gunmetal tube, restrained orange accents and one warm light-gray service panel. Large clean readable silhouette not dense tiny details. Both states static with ALL lamps/optics OFF, no firing, smoke, muzzle flash, shells, projectiles, beam, targets, humans or extra weapons. Both elevated front-left 3/4 views with whole gun/vehicle/feet visible and generous separation, single wide studio board warm gray ground and plain backdrop. No text, labels, borders or arrows. No dimensions/manufacturing diagrams. A fictional game artillery art proposal, not approved. Reference tank B only gives faction palette/material language; do not copy tank's enclosed turret. Make transport already identifiable by long exposed cradle and folded support assemblies, deployed much more identifiable by raised gun and spread feet.
howitzer.status: preliminary unapproved concept; two artistic states, not a verified shared 3D model
